versions.content: If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the function Fr_GetClockCorrection shall check whether the parameter Fr_OffsetCorrectionPtr is a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If Fr_OffsetCorrectionPtr is a NULL pointer, then the function Fr_GetClockCorrection shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER.
